Preferred Experience:

Position: Seasonal Elections Onsite Manager

Location: Rocklin, CA (Remote with the ability to meet with new hires as needed)

Pay: $31 to $32/hour 

Type: Full-time; Contract

Experience: Experience supervising frontline or hourly employees

Schedule: Variable Hours August – Mid-November

 

HB Staffing is seeking a Seasonal Elections Onsite Manager to join a growing and dynamic team! The Seasonal Elections Onsite Manager is responsible for owning workforce performance and delivery execution at assigned election sites during a high-volume, time-sensitive period. 

This role ensures that: 

  1. Shifts are filled  
  2. Associates show up and perform  
  3. Client expectations are consistently met  
  4. Issues are addressed in real-time  

This is a hands-on, high-accountability role that requires strong judgment, urgency, and the ability to make decisions quickly in a constantly changing environment. 


Core Objectives:

  1. Manage attendance and ensure daily shift coverage   
  2. Drive associate performance and accountability through active onsite management  
  3. Protect client satisfaction through responsiveness, communication, and follow-through  
  4. Reduce disruption and by addressing attendance, behavior, and performance issues immediately  

 

Key Responsibilities: 

Workforce Execution & Coverage 

  1. Own daily shift coverage across assigned sites; proactively identify and resolve gaps  
  2. Coordinate last-minute backfills in partnership with recruiting  
  3. Monitor attendance in real-time and take immediate action on callouts/no-shows  
  4. Maintain clear visibility into headcount, coverage risk, and upcoming needs  

 

Performance Management & Accountability 

  1. Set clear expectations with associates on attendance, conduct, and performance  
  2. Conduct onsite coaching, corrective conversations, and terminations as needed  
  3. Manage walk-offs, escalations, and behavior issues in real time  

 

Onsite Presence & Associate Experience 

  1. Maintain a visible onsite presence during key shifts and high-risk periods  
  2. As needed, meet new hires on their first day to ensure a strong start and clear expectations  
  3. Serve as the primary point of contact for associate concerns onsite  

 

Client Partnership  

  1. Build a strong working relationship with onsite client stakeholders  
  2. Collect real-time feedback on associate performance and operational gaps  
  3. Urgently escalate risks and onsite needs to the HB Staffing team  

 

Schedule & Work Detail  

  1. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in unstructured, fast-changing environments and is willing work non-traditional hours, including early mornings, evenings, and weekends  
  2. The Onsite Manager must lead from the front, demonstrating comfort jumping in and helping, being on site, and being the go-to person for the customer and associates.  


Job Perks:

  1. Health Benefits after 30 days!
  2. Weekly Paychecks!
  3. Career coaching opportunities!
